title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Arnold Palmer Invitational Upgrade
items.text: The Arnold Palmer Invitational at Bay Hill will be a PGA Tour Championship Series event starting in 2028 with a $20 million purse and a 120-player field.

items.headline: AIG Women's Open Lead Battle
items.text: Haeran Ryu leads the AIG Women's British Open at 7-under, one shot ahead of Shiho Kuwaki, with contenders Nelly Korda and Charley Hull within striking distance.

items.headline: LIV Golf Bankruptcy Report
items.text: Bloomberg reported that LIV Golf may file for bankruptcy under Chapter 11, posing financial uncertainty for the LIV series.
